name: Medical-Appointment
description: Medical appointment no-show prediction and analytics — Kaggle dataset, full feature engineering, EDA, and a trained ML model (HistGradientBoosting, ROC-AUC 0.74), deployed as an interactive Streamlit dashboard with a live risk calculator.

paragraphs: An end-to-end analytics and machine-learning project on 110,000+ real medical appointments from Brazil's public health system, delivered as an interactive Streamlit web application. The project combines an exploratory dashboard, a trained no-show prediction model with a full evaluation report, and a live risk calculator.
Live app: medical-appointment.streamlit.app Repository: github.com/shahndaa/Medical-Appointment Dataset: Medical Appointment No Shows, Kaggle

Roughly 20% of scheduled medical appointments in the dataset are no-shows, a costly problem for any healthcare provider. This project goes beyond a static notebook: it turns the analysis into a usable, deployed tool that answers two questions a clinic operations team would actually ask:
features: What patterns drive no-shows? (exploratory data analysis)
Which upcoming appointments are at risk, right now? (predictive model and interactive risk calculator)
Interactive filtering across date range, gender, age, neighbourhood, SMS reminder status, and scholarship status, with every chart updating live.
Overview — KPIs, monthly trend, show/no-show split, auto-generated insight callouts.
Demographics — age distribution, no-show rate by age group, gender, top neighbourhoods.
